title: A-Line Midi Cap Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant midi dress features a clean square neckline, sculpted bodice and soft paneled skirt that moves beautifully with every step. The flowing silhouette creates an elevated look that feels polished without being overdone, making it a versatile choice for wedding guests, rehearsal dinners, cocktail parties, formal dinners and evening celebrations.


Size Tip: If your measurements fall across different sizes, we recommend choosing based on your bust measurement first. For a more fitted look, you may choose one size down.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap Sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises crepe.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
